topics.text: Staff demonstrate consistent warmth and attentiveness, offering personalized recommendations and proactive assistance. Guests appreciate the welcoming atmosphere, with hosts ensuring comfort through small gestures like early check-in arrangements.

Rooms are spacious, modern, and aesthetically pleasing, featuring minimalist yet inviting decor. The layout caters to families, with child-friendly elements and comfortable furnishings enhancing the overall stay experience.

address: No. 33, Shangxiazhuang, Lanshukeng, Beihu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 空氣清新，迴歸大自然的感覺。別緻又安逸的小村莊，清晨可以聽到小鳥在院子裏叫，主人特別友好，離開時還送了伴手禮。
comments.author: Candy TangTT
comments.quoteEn: Fresh air and a real sense of being back in nature. A charming, easy little village, birds calling in the courtyard first thing, and hosts who were exceptionally friendly and sent us off with a gift.

comments.quote: 這家民宿超乾淨，靠山這麼近沒有一衹蚊子，泳池的水很清澈，早餐也很適口。停車方便，去周邊景點都很方便，是民宿中的上佳之選。
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 房間佈置得特別温馨，不是那種千篇一律的酒店風，感覺像在家裡一樣舒服。衞生做得也很到位，床單被套都是乾乾淨淨的，衞生間沒有一點異味
comments.author: Guest User
